program_name: Challenging the Frontiers of Poverty Reduction - Targeting the Ultra Poor (CFPR-TUP)
intervention_description: One-off transfer of livestock assets worth 10,000 taka to ultra-poor women, combined with orientation training, savings encouragement, health worker visits, and weekly technical advice

graduation_components_rationale.consumption_support: Weekly stipend of 70 taka provided to help protect against food insecurity
graduation_components_rationale.healthcare: Monthly visits by health workers included in programme components
graduation_components_rationale.assets: Transfer of livestock assets worth 10,000 taka to support enterprise development
graduation_components_rationale.skills_training: Orientation training on programme and chosen enterprise provided
graduation_components_rationale.savings: Participants encouraged to save in TUP fund immediately after joining
graduation_components_rationale.coaching: Weekly follow-up sessions to provide technical advice
graduation_components_rationale.social_empowerment: No explicit social empowerment activities mentioned
